objectives.title: Downstream Recipient Notification
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding notifying third-party recipients of personal data changes.
criteria: Writings requiring communication of personal data rectifications to recipients.
Writings requiring communication of personal data erasures to recipients.
Writings requiring communication of processing restrictions to recipients.
Contractual terms defining exemptions due to impossibility.
Contractual terms defining exemptions due to disproportionate effort.

objectives.title: Recipient Information Provision
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding disclosing recipient identities to data subjects.
criteria: Procedures for processing data subject requests regarding recipient identities.
Scope of disclosure limited to the recipients notified of the rectification, erasure, or restriction, rather than all recipients generally.
Obligations to disclose recipient lists to the data subject.
